summary: Clarify Fabric endpoint replacement and strengthen its atomic adapter regression proof

rules.detail: The adapter continues to replace its old NodeID record and exact grants in one revision-checked Fabric batch.

compatibility.detail: No runtime behavior changes. Local Fabric identity rotation is distinct from adapter policy replacement.

manual.detail: Do not assume atomic adapter policy replacement solves endpoint propagation after stopping the old Fabric identity.

recovery.detail: Static and other-owner grants on an old NodeID remain outside adapter authority.
